root.label: Medical plane missing near Nantucket with six on board

events.label: Medical plane missing near Nantucket with six on board

slots.name: people on board
slots.sentence: A medical jet with six people on board has gone missing near Nantucket while flying from Bermuda to Boston early Saturday, according to the U.S. Coast Guard and Federal Aviation Administration.

slots.name: flight duration
slots.sentence: It went missing after about 1 hour, 45 minutes in the air.

slots.name: last known altitude
slots.sentence: FlightAware data shows it quickly dropped from about 24,000 feet in the air to 11,000 feet before losing contact.

slots.name: contact lost time
slots.sentence: The FAA lost contact with the plane around 1 a.m. local time and issued a Search and Rescue Alert Notice for the Gulfstream G-100.

slots.name: search location
slots.sentence: The search was being conducted off the coast of Nantucket, according to the U.S. Coast Guard Northeast District.

slots.name: search assets
slots.sentence: The Coast Guard outlined the extensive assets involved in the search, including an HC-144 Ocean Sentry airplane, HC-130 Hercules airplane, MH-60 Jayhawk helicopter, a 47-foot Motor Lifeboat and the FRC William Sparling, a Sentinel-class fast response cutter.

slots.name: aircraft operator
slots.sentence: The jet is registered to Latitutde Air Ambulance, according to the tail number provided by the U.S. Coast Guard.

slots.name: takeoff time
slots.sentence: The plane took off at about 11:40 p.m. ET on Friday, according to data from FlightAware.
